| `defaultShare`    | `object`  |          | `null`                                                              | Initial value for the share toggle. `null` (the default) means the component looks up the active schema's `configuration.defaultAutoShare` via the OpenRegister schema API and seeds from there (falling back to false). A non-null Boolean wins over the schema lookup — let the consumer override the schema default when needed. `type` is intentionally omitted so Vue 2 accepts `null` without emitting a prop-type-check warning when a consumer passes `:default-share="null"` explicitly.
